name: CheckYourself
author: KyaniteLabs
description: The CheckYourself production-readiness check, packaged as a ResonantOS add-on: a deterministic local scan of a project directory that detects the stack, flags concrete risks (committed .env files, secret-shaped strings, missing tests or CI, TLS and CORS misconfigurations) ranked P0-P3, then scores findings 0-100, ranks the remediation backlog, and validates report artifacts against bundled schemas. Read-only: it inspects, it never modifies the scanned project. Vendored byte-identical from the upstream Apache-2.0 repo and wrapped by a thin local service with no dependencies.

grantPresets.label: Local project scans
grantPresets.description: Allow CheckYourself to read files under the configured scan root (CHECKYOURSELF_SCAN_ROOT, default the service working directory) to run its deterministic production-readiness scan. Read-only; scans never modify the project.

tools.name: checkyourself.status
tools.description: Report service version, busy state, the most recent scan id, and the active scan root boundary.

scan_root.description: Absolute scan boundary (home paths redacted to ~); scans are refused outside it

tools.name: checkyourself.scan
tools.description: The CheckYourself check itself (upstream verbs scan/diagnostic): read-only deterministic production-readiness scan of one project directory under the scan root. Detects stack signals, dependency hints, env files, tests, and CI; flags concrete risks as findings ranked P0-P3 (secret-shaped strings are redacted before they reach the output); returns counts, risk-surface hints, and the upstream public-repo claim guardrails. The project path must sit under CHECKYOURSELF_SCAN_ROOT. One scan at a time; results are also persisted home-path-redacted under var/. This is a scaffold, not the full AI diagnostic.

project.description: Project root path to inspect, confined to CHECKYOURSELF_SCAN_ROOT (default: the service process working directory)

deep.description: Run slower validation checks for detected surfaces, such as mutable GitHub Action references. Defaults to false.

max_files.description: Maximum files to scan before truncating (default 6000). Truncation is reported in scan_limits.

project.description: Resolved project root, home paths redacted to ~

evidence.description: file:line context; secret-shaped values already redacted upstream

scan_id.description: Wrapper-assigned id; the same redacted result is persisted at record_path

record_path.description: Addon-relative path of the persisted redacted scan.json under var/

tools.name: checkyourself.score
tools.description: Compute the deterministic Production Reality Score (0-100, with severity caps and explicit confidence) from inline findings and an optional coverage object. Coverage-backed scores are the only ones that can reach high confidence; scan-derived and finding-only estimates are always labeled low confidence.

findings.description: A checkyourself-scan/1 object, a CheckYourself report object, an object with findings/remediation_backlog, or a plain list of finding objects

coverage.description: Optional filled coverage object; supply it for coverage-backed scoring

tools.name: checkyourself.backlog
tools.description: Normalize inline findings and return the complete remediation backlog sorted by severity, category, and finding id — each item with fix summary, order rationale, verification, rollback idea, learning value, and status — plus the safest first approval batch. Recommends work only; it never modifies files.

findings.description: A scan result, report, object with findings/remediation_backlog, or a plain list of finding objects

tools.name: checkyourself.validate
tools.description: Validate an inline JSON artifact against one of the bundled CheckYourself schema subsets (scan, coverage, score, backlog, next, diff, report, dashboard, dashboard-data, learning-plan, capabilities) and return the validation errors, if any.

tools.name: checkyourself.schema
tools.description: Return one of the bundled CheckYourself JSON schemas by name, so an agent can inspect expected fields before producing or validating artifacts.

outputSchema.description: The requested bundled JSON schema (checkyourself-*.schema.json contents)
